action: MMSEを実施または記録を確認
fallback: Structured proxy: MCI or Alzheimer's disease coded within 180 days.
label: MMSE 22〜30点
note_question: Do the notes record a Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) total score from 22 to 30 within the 180 days before the index date? An HDS-R score alone does not answer this.
text: スクリーニング前180日以内のMMSEが22点以上30点以下の者（HDS-Rでの代用は不可）。
